# STANIAX Sp. z o.o. — Industrial Vacuum Metallization (PVD), Reflector Restoration & Coating

> Engineering-grade surface treatment partner in Central Poland (since 1993, founded by Dariusz Staniak). Production facility near Warsaw serving B2B OEMs, automotive workshops, cosmetic/spirits packaging manufacturers, and lighting producers across Poland and the European Union.

## Core Capabilities & Verified Technical Specifications
- **PVD Vacuum Metallization Chambers:** Industrial vacuum deposition chambers up to Ø 1200 mm with planetary rotary racks for uniform aluminium (99.99% purity) nanometric coatings.
- **Reflective Optics Restoration:** Directional light reflectance **>92%** restored on automotive H7, Bi-Xenon, Bi-LED, Hella/Valeo/Bosch, motorcycle, truck 24V, and classic car (oldtimer/youngtimer) reflectors; heat-resistant primer systems up to 220 °C + SiOx protective layer; 24-month warranty; 2–5 working days turnaround.
- **Substrates Handled:** ABS, PC, PC/ABS, PMMA, PS, SAN, PA (polyamide), PP (low-pressure plasma activation), PET, glass, ceramics, aluminium/ZnAl die-castings, and thermally sensitive composites.
- **Quality Control Standards:** Cross-hatch adhesion Class 0 per **ISO 2409**, spectrophotometric color control **ΔE < 0.8**, gloss measurement from deep matte (<5 GU) to Piano Black high gloss (>92 GU), 96% ethanol chemical resistance for perfumery glass.
- **Coating Systems:** UV-cured VOC-free lacquers, 2K polyurethane (2K PU), epoxy & ESD coatings, waterborne silane-promoted glass systems, full RAL / NCS / Pantone color matching, frosted etched-look without HF acid, ombre gradients.
